ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: Dear ImGui 1.93.0, an immediate mode GUI library
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: Dear ImGui of the master line (no docking, no multi viewports) as a shared library, so that the application, the GUI driver library guidriverImGui and the renderer plugins share one current context, one allocator and one set of globals; a static library on the web, where everything links into one binary. imconfig.h holds the GUCEF configuration (32-bit indices and characters, no file, shell or Win32 functions, no stb_truetype, no obsolete functions, assertions and the debug log through imgui_gucef.cpp). The backends, examples, documentation and misc folders of upstream are not built. Dear ImGui needs C++11.
